answers.label: A
answers.text: Not existing for a few hours. No output. No input.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Reading, or something small that asks nothing of you.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Holding still. Not trying to fix the feeling. Just letting it be.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Something active — a hike, a game. Rest isn't passive for you.

questions.question: When the environment is too loud or too much:

answers.label: A
answers.text: You raise your own signal to match it. You don't retreat.

answers.label: B
answers.text: You find the quietest corner and build your own zone.

answers.label: C
answers.text: You feel it accumulate. Eventually something has to give.

answers.label: D
answers.text: You leave. Or you go quiet inside it and wait it out.

questions.question: A decision that's been sitting too long:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Find the one thing that matters most and let that be the answer.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Keep turning it over. You'll know when you know.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Let it sit until it decides itself. You trust that.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Just decide. You can correct later. Waiting is the problem.

questions.question: When you need to recharge, you:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Disappear. No calls, no plans, no explaining yourself.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Sleep, or a long walk. Something that asks nothing of you.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Sit with it. Don't try to fix the feeling yet.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Do something physical. Your body knows before your mind does.

questions.question: The thing that makes you feel most like yourself:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Building something that's working and you can feel it working.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Getting through something difficult and still standing at the end.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Knowing what you're doing and why. That clarity.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Being alone and not performing anything for anyone.
